254:t_011:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Quit hiding in the shadows and come out!」

254:t_012:0.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「A warrior of the $$ゲッター線$$...!」

254:t_012:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「No - one whose fate is toyed with by the $$ゲッター線$$!」

254:t_012:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So you're still alive, huh! $$コーウェン$$! $$スティンガー$$!」

254:t_012:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「W-What are those people!? They're out in space with their bare bodies!」

254:t_012:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「M-Monsters! Okay, the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s over there look worse, but those people... are genuine, honest-to-goodness monsters!」

254:t_012:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「For once, I agree with what $$ノノ$$ says.」

254:t_012:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「Those guys are $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$... They used to be scientists from Earth, but they've been parasitized by the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s.」

254:t_012:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「And they led a huge army of $$インベーダー#pilot$$s and tried to seize the Earth, where the $$ゲッター線$$ gather.」

254:t_012:9.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「They're an unknown energy that pours down from space. They're believed to have the power to make living things evolve.」

254:t_012:10.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Dr. $$早乙女#getter$$, who researched the $$ゲッター線$$, developed the $$ゲッター$$ Robo, which uses them as its power source.」

254:t_012:11.en:
$$勝平$$
「Those old geezers... We beat them black and blue in the $$再世戦争$$, and they still haven't learned their lesson!?」

254:t_012:12.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「You still don't understand. From our point of view, that defeat meant nothing at all.」

254:t_012:13.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「We are the ones chosen by the $$ゲッター線$$. In other words, living beings who have been promised eternity.」

254:t_012:17.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'm sick of hearing your delusional nonsense! If you've come back to life, this time I'll knock you down to an even deeper hell!」

254:t_012:18.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「You still do not understand the $$ゲッター線$$, $$流竜馬$$.」

254:t_012:19.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Even though it was the power of the $$ゲッター線$$ that threw you all here.」

254:t_012:21.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「Let us put it in simpler terms.」

254:t_012:22.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「It is all because of you, $$流竜馬$$.」

254:t_012:23.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You keep rambling on about nonsense!」

254:t_012:24.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「You yourself must have noticed it.」

254:t_013:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
(I don't know why... But my heart is getting hotter...!)

254:t_013:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
(What am I...! What the hell am I!?)

254:t_013:3.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「If you have come here to die of your own accord, so much the better.」

254:t_013:4.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「We will dispose of you, $$流竜馬$$.」

254:t_014:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Is this any time to be stubborn!?」

254:t_014:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「An unfamiliar place, a mighty enemy... And the vast universe...」

254:t_014:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Perfect! I can feel my fighting spirit welling up from deep inside my body!」

254:t_014:9.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「He's a warrior through and through.」

254:t_014:10.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's the kind of man $$流竜馬$$ is.」

254:t_014:11.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「Grr! You still keep resisting!」

254:t_014:12.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「In that case... we will end your life! Finish you off completely!!」

254:t_015:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「It has been a while, $$正太郎$$. And you warriors of $c.」

254:t_015:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$! It really is you, $$グーラ$$!」

254:t_015:3.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Greetings can wait. First, I will dispose of those pitiful bugs.」

254:t_015:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「So $$グーラ$$ fights the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s too...!」

254:t_015:5.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「The prince of the incarnation of cosmic darkness...!」

254:t_015:6.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「And you, of all things, call us bugs...!」

254:t_015:7.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...I am no different from you. I am like a bug, born in darkness and drawn to the light.」

254:t_015:9.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...Earthlings reach the radiance of the sun.」

254:t_015:10.en:
$n
「Blood of the beast, mingling of waters, destination of the wind, civilization of fire... And the radiance of the sun...」

254:t_015:12.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Are you saying these wretches were chosen by the $$ゲッター線$$!?」

254:t_015:13.en:
$$グーラ$$
「The proof of it will be here soon.」

254:t_016:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So you're here, $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$!」

254:t_016:1.en:
$$渓$$
「Wait up, $$グーラ$$! You're too fast!」

254:t_016:2.en:
$$凱$$
「We got thrown out to a place like this out of nowhere, you know! Show us a little consideration!」

254:t_016:4.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Still, what a surprise. Just like $$グーラ$$ said, we found $c out here.」

254:t_016:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「Fighting even in a place like this, huh. Same old fate as ever.」

254:t_016:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Spare me! And you guys who keep going along with it are the same breed!」

254:t_017:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Stop him... stop the $$ゲッター$$ Robo!」
